title: Events
excerpt: Explore the fundamentals of event-driven programming in Python. Learn how to implement a simple event system from scratch, understanding the core concepts of event emission and listening. This post demonstrates how to build a basic event library that facilitates real-time communication between different parts of your application.

title: Thread Exhaustion Due to GetAwaiter().GetResult() in C#
excerpt: Learn about thread starvation issues in C# when using GetAwaiter().GetResult() with async APIs. This post explores the problems that arise from synchronous blocking in async operations and provides best practices to avoid thread exhaustion.
